test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six doctors are sitting in a row facing north, Omprakash is sitting third to the left of Tanvi, who is sitting second to the right of Matank. Yadhu is sitting to the immediate right of Sunil, who is sitting somewhere to the left of Omprakash. Neither Yadhu nor Karuna sit at the extreme ends. What is Karuna's position with respect to Yadhu?
solution:
Six doctors Omprakash, Tanvi, Matank, Yadhu, Sunil and Karuna are sitting in a row facing north. 

1) Omprakash is sitting third to the left of Tanvi, who is sitting second to the right of Matank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abe4064325febdd07c03ea08c45ff21043403f1cca6b00cadfa36b7c294775a3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26e5faf6211234b908dda413f72e6891f8be4ba071a010468c160a964ccc5188.png] 

2) Yadhu is sitting to the immediate right of sunil, who is sitting somewhere to the left of Omprakash.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da4d9c08089deb316ae4514faf31ed23fd4ee6ce11cf6b702adb10c0e46d4815.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaf2bcb2239fc352cf7205529f4a0a9f212301722888052e85321c179965a6bc.png] 

3) Neither Yadhu nor Karuna sit at the extreme ends .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe928f7771452c005ce9ad00e25f56cc8b24f5272f2e0acdad6936c575379372.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dda6fdaf1363e70b215cc7b1ee936a0d323c214ba090c4585f4681311217c7ff.png] 

From the above seating arrangement, Karuna's position with respect to Yadhu is **Third to the right**. 

Hence, 'Third to the right' is the correct answer**.**
